load_config_yaml: load a YAML configuration file and return it as a Python dictionary
review_load_config: review the load_config function that reads and parses YAML config files
test_load_config: test the load_config function by loading a sample YAML config file
refactor_load_config: refactor the load_config function to add validation or default config fallback
summarize_load_config: summarize the load_config function that uses PyYAML to parse config files
